conditions.label: Has employees
conditions.description: Pays wages or salaries and runs a payroll.

conditions.label: Registered for VAT
conditions.description: Registered for value added tax or a similar turnover tax.

profileFields.label: Company name
profileFields.description: The registered name, including the Partnership legal form. Registered under the Partnership Act 2018.

profileFields.label: Registration number
profileFields.description: The number the company register gave the company.

profileFields.label: Registered office address
profileFields.description: The address on the company register.

profileFields.label: Share capital
profileFields.description: The capital the company was registered with. Leave it empty if the form has no share capital.

roles.label: Partner
roles.description: Owns a share of the partnership.

setupSteps.title: Choose and check the Partnership name
setupSteps.description: Check the name is free in Corporations, Partnerships, Associations and Trusts Registration Division and follows Nauru's naming rules.
setupSteps.authority: Corporations, Partnerships, Associations and Trusts Registration Division

setupSteps.title: Prepare the Partnership documents
setupSteps.description: Prepare the articles or statutes, the founders' details and the registered office. The registration process sets out what it needs.
setupSteps.authority: Corporations, Partnerships, Associations and Trusts Registration Division

setupSteps.title: Register the Partnership
setupSteps.description: Submit the incorporation documents as Corporations, Partnerships, Associations and Trusts Registration Division requires. The company exists once the register enters it.
setupSteps.authority: Corporations, Partnerships, Associations and Trusts Registration Division

setupSteps.title: Register the Partnership for tax
setupSteps.description: Register with Nauru Revenue Office for the company's tax number and any VAT or payroll accounts it needs.

setupSteps.title: Register as an employer
setupSteps.description: Before the first hire, register with Nauru Superannuation Scheme for payroll and social contributions.

setupSteps.title: Open a business bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks usually ask for the registration certificate and the tax number.

setupSteps.title: Check licences for your activity
setupSteps.description: Some activities need a permit or a licence from a sector regulator. Check before you start trading.

obligations.title: Annual return or confirmation statement
obligations.description: Check whether an annual return or confirmation statement is due with Corporations, Partnerships, Associations and Trusts Registration Division, then file it and keep the company record current.
obligations.authority: Corporations, Partnerships, Associations and Trusts Registration Division

obligations.title: Annual financial statements
obligations.description: Prepare the annual accounts. Check whether they must be filed with Corporations, Partnerships, Associations and Trusts Registration Division, the deadline and whether an audit is required.
obligations.authority: Corporations, Partnerships, Associations and Trusts Registration Division

obligations.title: Partnership tax return
obligations.description: File the partnership's information return with Nauru Revenue Office. The partners report their share on their own returns.

obligations.title: VAT returns
obligations.description: File VAT returns with Nauru Revenue Office and pay any VAT due. Check whether the company is registered and how often it files.

obligations.title: Payroll taxes and social contributions
obligations.description: Withhold and remit payroll taxes and social contributions for employees through Nauru Superannuation Scheme. Check the rates and dates.

obligations.title: Beneficial ownership information
obligations.description: Check whether the country requires a beneficial ownership filing. If it does, keep the record up to date and file it with Corporations, Partnerships, Associations and Trusts Registration Division.
obligations.authority: Corporations, Partnerships, Associations and Trusts Registration Division

obligations.title: Report changes to the register
obligations.description: Check what changes must be reported to Corporations, Partnerships, Associations and Trusts Registration Division, then tell it about changes to the name, address, directors or share capital within its deadline.
obligations.authority: Corporations, Partnerships, Associations and Trusts Registration Division

obligations.title: Renew licences and permits
obligations.description: Check which licences your activity needs and renew them before they expire.
